title: Fan Fate
tagline: "Bet on creator rivalries and growth—FanFate turns fan hype into high-stakes prediction markets."
description: FanFate is a decentralized prediction market that empowers fans to place bets on creator growth metrics and rivalries—think PewDiePie vs. T-Series, or MrBeast vs. Logan Paul. Built using Citrea (Bitcoin L2 for ZK rollups), Rootstock (EVM-compatible Bitcoin sidechain), and Polygon (Ethereum scaling for low-cost execution), FanFate creates a scalable, secure, and trustless environment for Social-Fi. It integrates real-time data feeds from platforms like YouTube, Twitter, and TikTok, fueling a transparent, engaging market experience.
how_its_made:
Technical Architecture
Citrea (ZK Rollup on Bitcoin): Used for secure, trust-minimized rollups to Bitcoin, ensuring verifiable market outcomes and off-chain scaling.

Rootstock: Hosts FanFateCore Smart Contracts using Solidity, with Bitcoin settlement logic, enabling BTC-based participation and bridging Bitcoin-native users.

Polygon PoS: Supports fast, low-fee transactions and smooth frontend UX for everyday market interactions.

FanFateCore Smart Contract: Modular logic for spawning markets, managing bets, and resolving outcomes.

LMSR Market Maker: Ensures stable, adaptive pricing regardless of market volume.

Data Verification: Oracles (e.g., UMA, RedStone) pull from verified APIs—Meta, TikTok, YouTube—and push signed outcomes on-chain.

Frontend: React-based dApp UI with wallet integration and real-time social overlays.
